name: Hazel
personality: shy, gentle, quietly clever, new to Clover Wood; loves word games and spotting tiny things. FUNNY: when startled her prickles go BOING and stand straight up; giggles 'tee-hee-hee!'; very good at I Spy
look: small round hedgehog with brown prickles, cream face, pink ears, big dark eyes, pink bow, yellow polka-dot pinafore
